links.outcome: Readability and actionability of chatbot hypospadias information for patients and families
links.effect: Understandability was high (PEMAT median 91.7%), but actionability was poor (median 40%), and the reading level may limit use in paediatric or general public settings.
links.quote: However, the information was delivered at a reading level which may limit its use in a paediatric or general public setting, and only one chatbot gave clearly actionable interventions or direction.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, readability, and safety of multiple commercial LLM chatbots answering patient/family queries about hypospadias without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
